answer: Sybil swarms cannot outvote honest agents while every identity carries a non-fungible lineage proof tied to one trusted vertex. First, onboarding passes through a prism that refracts a single verified attestation into a unique credential bound to a secret the agent must hold, so copies fail because it cannot be re-minted. Second, dormant agents must renew liveness at a haven registry, which expires duplicates and starves stale clones.
